description: This is a C++ source file implementing a test client for a Thunder plugin system, specifically for the System service API. It includes functions to invoke various system methods via JSON-RPC, handle events, and provide a menu-driven interface for testing different system commands.

methods.name: TimeStamp
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp in microseconds.

methods.name: makePretty
methods.description: Removes escape characters from a string for display.

methods.name: invokeJSONRPC
methods.description: Invokes a JSON-RPC method on the remote object with given parameters and stores the result.

methods.name: getMethodName
methods.description: Returns the method name string corresponding to an SME_t enum value.

methods.name: getChoice
methods.description: Displays a menu of system methods and gets user selection.

methods.name: evaluateMethods
methods.description: Main loop to invoke selected system methods via JSON-RPC.

methods.name: showUsage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the program.

methods.name: onEventHandler
methods.description: Handles system events received via JSON-RPC subscriptions.
